title: Can AI Reason Like an Urban Planner? Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Professional Judgment
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLMs on 'phronetic expertise', which incorporates value awareness, normative judgment, and ethical reasoning. It specifically identifies 'Wickedness Paralysis' (the retreat from normative commitment) and 'phronetic deficit' (lack of practical/moral wisdom) as key failure modes in AI reasoning.
